policies.name: Decreto SUP — Single-Use Plastics Decree
policies.summary: Italy's transposition of the EU SUP Directive: bans single-use plastic cutlery, plates, straws, stirrers, and polystyrene cups and food containers.

sources.publisher: Ministero dell'Ambiente e della Sicurezza Energetica

newsFeed.headline: Mediterranean plastic monitoring shows Italian beaches still dominated by cigarette butts and bottle caps
newsFeed.summary: An annual cleanup audit found cigarette filters and plastic bottle caps still topped the Italian beach-litter list, despite EU bans.

wooby.headline: Italy recycles half its plastic and bans single-use cutlery.
wooby.narrative: Wooby loves the warm Mediterranean Sea around Italy. Italy banned plastic forks and plates and recycles about half of its plastic. But cigarette butts on the beach are still a problem. Wooby asks: please put them in the bin!
